agones_log_policy: The source Watch error callback binds the successful construction error rather than the callback argument. The native implementation retains path/message and error:null using Option; it does not reconstruct Go typed-nil interfaces. Fatal backend termination still propagates through the owned lifetime task.

ecosystem_reuse.custom_policy_reason: Agones requires fixed-window batching, certificate reload callbacks and parent-owned cleanup. The bridge supplies only this integration; notify owns platform notification parsing, handles and backend workers.
ecosystem_reuse.event_policy: Read/open access events do not retrigger reload. Write-close and create/modify/remove/other/rescan notifications wake fixed-window batching through Tokio Notify; native watcher errors use a Tokio error channel.
ecosystem_reuse.features: Default platform selection; one-second interval for the portable polling fallback.
ecosystem_reuse.lockfile_provenance: Cargo.lock changed after the manifest edit without any Cargo invocation by this agent. Actor attribution is unconfirmed. The observed graph is bound as source configuration only; dependency resolution/build/verification is not credited.

operations.agones_requirement: Register the requested path non-recursively, return registration failures and cancel the partial watch on startup failure. Watch directories and immediate children for certificate replacement events.

Start a fixed batch window on the first change, retain that deadline during a burst, and invoke the callback once for the batch. Hold changes received while the callback runs for the next batch. Handle watcher errors and terminate on cancellation or a failed backend stream.

Own backend lifetime and callback tasks in the existing scope, close idempotently and await callback-owner destruction during normal cleanup. Drive rejected futures through cleanup before returning an error. Rust RAII requests closure on abort or unwind.

Watch /certs/ with a one-second batching window, reload the configured certificate pair, retain the previous certificate after load errors and publish a successfully loaded pair through the existing certificate owner. Preserve watcher-start failure logging/exit behavior.

production_composition.library_worker_scope: notify owns native backend workers and exposes no common JoinHandle. Callback destruction is observed; no direct native-thread join or runtime cleanup proof is claimed.
production_composition.normal_shutdown: Cancel, drop the library watcher once, wait for callback lifetime completion and join owned application tasks. Emergency Drop requests closure through RAII.
production_composition.state_owner: One NativeWatch owns the library watcher; batchWatch owns its timer. EventBridge owns notification delivery and its destruction acknowledges library callback lifetime completion.
production_composition.task_owner: Existing UtilityRuntimeOwner/UtilityTaskScope owns one backend lifetime future and one batch-callback future per watcher. No independent application manager or detached application tasks.
